findings.text: Biggest gain: T1, +0.37 s for VER L39 over LEC L36. Brakes 10 m later, carries 5 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #2: Start to T1, +0.37 s for LEC L36 over VER L39. Reaches 23 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #3: T13, +0.32 s for VER L39 over LEC L36. Carries 4 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #4: T4, +0.30 s for VER L39 over LEC L36. Brakes 7 m later, carries 7 km/h more minimum speed, gets on the throttle 16 m later.
Gain #5: T10, +0.22 s for VER L39 over LEC L36. Exits 5 km/h slower.
